mappings.reasoning: MATNR is the SAP material number, which serves as the product SKU identifier; values are zero-padded strings so they should be kept as text rather than cast to integer.
MAKTX is the SAP material description, containing human-readable product names like 'Sac Lune cuir grainé noir'.
MTART is the SAP material type (FERT = finished product, VERP = packaging), which is not a product category and has no clean target; dropping it avoids a misleading mapping.
MATKL is the SAP material group (BAGS, ACCS, SHOE, RTW, PACK), which corresponds to product category.
NETPR is the net price stored as a German-formatted string (dot thousands separator, comma decimal), so it needs parsing into a decimal amount.
WAERS is the SAP currency key and contains the ISO code EUR, matching price.currency.
LABST is unrestricted stock quantity, but it is formatted as a decimal string with three fractional zeros (e.g. '12,000'), so it must be parsed and then converted to an integer count.
ERSDA is the SAP record creation date stored as YYYYMMDD, which maps to created_at after date parsing.
